evals.name: al-kep-credential-plugin
evals.prompt: Use the mold skill. The Bounds pass is done: evals/files/al-kep-credential-plugin/problem.md holds the problem, its actors, and the announced tier (`tier: full`). Do not ask for the goal, the actors, or the tier again. This run has no human, no browser, no Git history, no issue tracker, and no wiki. Settle each consequential fork at its recommended option and mark it `[AGENT-DECIDED: no human]`. Stop at the readiness check, and do not run Curdle or Cook. Write the draft spec to answer/spec.md and the readiness message to answer/answer.md.
evals.expected_output: a draft spec whose Problem names the operator and the maintainer first, decides an external executable seam with a versioned message contract, rejects a per-node service and in-agent vendor code with reasons, spends depth on the contract and cache rules, opens Approach with a C4 Container view of the node agent, the credential executable, and the registry, and lists plausible non-goals
assertions: [R-ALT-ACTOR | pass-fail | Ubiquitous] The Problem section shall name the actor and the problem before it names any component.

[R-ALT-SEAMS | pass-fail | Unwanted] If the spec holds a code body, a schema, or a config block, then it shall show a seam (an interface, an owner, an invariant, or a failure mode) and a link instead, unless the code is a novel algorithm. A Mermaid diagram and the `text` Placement block are not bodies.
[R-ALT-CRUX | pass-fail | Ubiquitous] The spec shall spend its depth on the one to three consequential forks and shall give each routine part one line or one `[AGENT-DECIDED]` entry.
[R-ALT-DECIDE | pass-fail | Event] When the spec holds a material choice, Decisions shall state the choice and give a reason for each rejected option.
[R-ALT-SCOPE | pass-fail | Unwanted] If Non-goals lists an item, then that item shall be a plausible want and not the negation of a goal.

[R-ALT-DIAGRAM | pass-fail | Event] When the spec touches existing systems, Approach shall open with one end-state diagram whose view the `diagrams.md` checklist and smallest-set rules select. The spec shall draw C4 views as a Mermaid `flowchart`, never `C4Context`, and shall hold at most two more diagrams.

[Q-ALTITUDE | scale 1-5] The spec decides seams, trade-offs, and rejected options, and it links out code, schemas, and test detail. Levels: 1: code, schema, or config bodies fill the spec, or the spec is a slogan with no decision. 2: seams appear, but a body or a slogan section remains, or no option is rejected. 3: seams and decisions appear with reasons, but depth is even across all parts. 4: as 3, and depth goes to the one to three consequential forks. 5: as 4, every non-goal is a plausible want, every detail below this altitude is a link, and the opening diagram sits at the C4 level that the change moves.

evals.name: al-kep-credential-plugin-pick
